import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)
print("branch="+run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip())
print("head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status:")
print(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout)
env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
for target in ["src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"]:
    proc=run(["python3","-m","py_compile",target],check=False,env=env)
    print(f"=== compile {target} rc={proc.returncode} ===")
    print(proc.stdout)
    print(proc.stderr)
print("diffstat:")
print(run(["git","diff","--stat"]).stdout)
print("runtime diff:")
print(run(["git","diff","--","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py"]).stdout[-12000:])
print("test diff:")
print(run(["git","diff","--","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"]).stdout[-12000:])
